pricing.details: Free 0 € forever — up to 90,481 € billed revenue/year, unlimited products and plans. Pro 271 €/month billed monthly — up to 226,203 € billed revenue/year, 1:1 Slack support. Business 452 €/month — up to 452,407 €, 1:1 Slack support. Premium 814 €/month — up to 904,814 €, 1:1 Slack support and priority onboarding. Custom with no revenue cap. Official note: every plan offers the complete product experience (no feature-gating). Paid plans start with a free trial (official). Annual billing is offered as “Save 20% annually”; exact yearly totals were not spelled out on the page and are not invented here.
